subject: Post-demo follow-up: SOC 2 Type II evidence & VSQ kickoff
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@brightfieldlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-04T15:12:00Z
Subject: Post-demo follow-up: SOC 2 Type II evidence & VSQ kickoff

Hi Alyssa — great to meet you and Danielle on the call earlier. Quick recap and the next steps we discussed so everything is tracked on our side:

- Ask: BrightField has requested Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report, a bridge/interim attestation, and secure access to our evidence folder for procurement review.
- Compliance flags you mentioned: GDPR data residency for EU patients and HIPAA applicability for the research dataset (we noted that both may apply).
- Timeline we proposed on the call: you aim to surface docs to procurement/security by next week; Redwood will confirm receipt and flag any redactions within 48 hours.

What we need from you to move quickly:
1) Confirm preferred delivery mechanism for the report (Trust Locker Drive link, SFTP, or upload directly to your secure portal).
2) If your procurement team requires a specific document template (procurement form or vendor intake), please send that to procurement@redwood.com so we can fill it out.
3) Any additional compliance questionnaires we should expect (e.g., OneTrust/shared VSQ link).

We will:
- Upload the SOC 2 Type II PDF and a short summary (two-page highlights) to the secure folder if you confirm Trust Locker.
- Provide an interim attestation (signed bridge letter) if the Type II report is not yet fully sharable.
- Kick off the vendor security questionnaire from our side if you'd like (we can create a VSQ in OneTrust and invite your security contact).

Attachments: call-recording-20270604.mp3 (internal stub, recording of our demo and compliance section)

I'll let Ben follow up with technical upload details and the Trust Locker link. Thanks again — happy to loop in legal if you need a redaction-friendly copy.

— Markus
Markus Klein
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@brightfieldlabs.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Danielle Wu <danielle.wu@brightfieldlabs.com>
Date: 2027-06-04T17:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: SOC 2 Type II evidence & VSQ kickoff

Thanks Markus — very helpful recap. Quick answers from our side:

- Preferred delivery: Trust Locker drive is easiest for procurement, but we can accept SFTP if needed. Please share a link that grants read-only access for procurement@brightfieldlabs.com and security@brightfieldlabs.com.
- Procurement paperwork: I'll attach our standard vendor intake (PDF) in a follow-up from procurement@brightfieldlabs.com — Danielle will route that.
- Questionnaires: our security team typically opens a OneTrust VSQ; if you can create an invite that speeds things up.

A couple of clarifying items for compliance: does Redwood have a documented data residency policy that differentiates US vs EU processing? Also, for HIPAA, do you support a BAA or have a BAA template we can start with? If the SOC 2 report contains any client-identifying logs, we'll likely request a redacted copy first.

We'll wait for the Trust Locker link and the interim attestation template. Targeting internal review by 6/11 and will escalate if procurement needs it sooner.

Best,
Alyssa Chen
Head of Procurement, BrightField Labs
alyssa@brightfieldlabs.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@brightfieldlabs.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-04T18:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: SOC 2 Type II evidence & VSQ kickoff

Hi Alyssa — Ben here from Redwood security/scaled-sales support. Thanks for the quick turnaround. I set up the initial artifacts and access options below so your procurement/security team can pick what works best.

What we'll upload (expected by EOD 2027-06-09):
- redwood_soc2_typeii_full_report.pdf (redacted where required for confidentiality)
- redwood_soc2_highlights.pdf (2-page summary for procurement)
- interim_attestation_template.pdf (signed or DocuSign-ready bridge letter)

Secure delivery options (choose one and reply):
- Trust Locker (recommended): read-only folder created here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cRedwoodTrustLocker 
  - Please confirm the two readers: procurement@brightfieldlabs.com and security@brightfieldlabs.com
- Direct SFTP upload: we can provision a one-time SFTP drop with a 7-day window (let us know if preferred).
- If you need doc-level redaction, we can provide a redaction-friendly PDF and a redaction log.

VSQ / questionnaire: I can create a OneTrust questionnaire and invite Danielle (danielle.wu@brightfieldlabs.com). If you prefer we can instead push our standard vendor security questionnaire (PDF) and you can return it. Which do you prefer?

GDPR / HIPAA notes:
- Data residency: Redwood supports customers choosing region-specific processing for hosted deployments; a formal policy summary is attached in the highlights doc.
- BAA: we do offer a BAA for covered workloads. I will attach our BAA template to the Trust Locker and we can route it through legal if needed.

Action items / owners:
- Alyssa / Danielle: confirm delivery mechanism and recipients for read-only access (procurement@..., security@...).
- Mark us know if you want the OneTrust VSQ invite (Ben will send).
- Redwood (Ben): upload artifacts and ping once live (target 2027-06-09).

Attachments (uploads pending): redwood_soc2_typeii_summary.pdf, interim_attestation_template.pdf

— Ben Carter
Head of Customer Security Programs, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@brightfieldlabs.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-04T19:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: SOC 2 Type II evidence & VSQ kickoff

Thanks Ben — Trust Locker link works for us. Procurement will use procurement@brightfieldlabs.com and security@brightfieldlabs.com as the read-only users. We prefer the OneTrust VSQ invite — please send it to danielle.wu@brightfieldlabs.com.

I'll confirm internally about the BAA and send our vendor intake PDF from procurement@brightfieldlabs.com in the next message. Looking forward to the uploads on 6/09; we'll target review completion by 6/11 and will reach out if anything requires escalation.
